# RioCharts

> Charts for .NET: one chart model (line, area, bar, scatter, pie, donut, radial bar, radar, heatmap, box plot, candlestick, treemap), interactive in Blazor, PNG and SVG on the server (RioCharts.Skia), and created by AI agents from JSON definitions. Preview packages for .NET 10 and .NET 11.

Setup: `dotnet add package RioCharts.Blazor --prerelease`, then `@using RioCharts.Blazor` and `@using RioCharts.Core` in `_Imports.razor`. Nothing to register. A chart:

```razor
<RioChart Items="orders">
    <BarSeries XValue="o => o.Country" YValue="o => (double)o.Value" Aggregate="Aggregate.Sum" />
</RioChart>
```

Tooltips, zoom and clicks need an interactive render mode. Set `TItem` on `<RioChart>` when it has event handlers. .NET MAUI Blazor Hybrid apps work the same way, with no render mode (tested on Windows; Android and iOS not yet).

## Guide for coding agents

- [llms-full.txt](https://riocharts.com/llms-full.txt): setup, rules, compiled examples and every component parameter in one file. Read this before writing RioCharts code.

## Beyond Blazor

- [Chart definitions](https://riocharts.com/definitions): the chart model as JSON, with a playground
- [Server-side export](https://riocharts.com/server-export): PNG and SVG with RioCharts.Skia
- [AI agents and MCP](https://riocharts.com/ai): create_chart for agents in your app, and `riocharts-mcp`, a local MCP server that renders charts and turns definitions into Razor
